transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

After losing a full-time job opportunity at an arts nonprofit that I was really counting on, I feel like I’ve been reacting badly to everything. I just can't seem to cope with what's happening in my life right now.
How long ago did you lose that job opportunity, and did these feelings start soon after it happened?

The job fell through about two months ago, and these feelings started really quickly, within a couple of weeks of hearing the news. Before that, I was actually doing completely fine and managing my life well. It was only after losing that opportunity that I felt like I couldn't cope anymore.

Since this started, how much has it affected your day-to-day life, like work, relationships, or taking care of yourself? Are you still able to function, or does it feel significantly harder than usual?

It has made functioning so much harder, and I've started avoiding almost everything. I've lost out on paid gig work, stopped going to my regular improv group, and am letting emails about my student loans and lease pile up. Now I'm really worried I'm going to miss payments or not have a place to live, but I just freeze up when I try to deal with it.

Since this started, have you had a lot of sadness, loss of interest, panic attacks, or thoughts of hurting yourself that feel stronger than just reacting to the job loss? Or does it mainly feel tied to that stressor and ease up when you're not thinking about it?

It is definitely tied directly to the job loss and everything being up in the air, rather than a separate issue. I don't have panic attacks, thoughts of hurting myself, or deep depression unrelated to this stressor. I really feel like once I get a stable job or a new plan sorted out, these feelings will resolve.

Besides the lost job opportunity, has anything else major happened that could be driving these symptoms, and have they been present most days for the past two months? Have there been any periods during that time when you felt back to your usual self for a week or more?

The job loss was the main trigger, but it also set off other major stressors like my student loans coming due and my lease needing renewal. These feelings have been constant almost every day for the past two months. I haven't had any periods where I felt back to my usual self at all since it happened.
